verdicts.evidence: app/test/home_screen_test.dart:2885-2896 is the only test that taps Trade this, and it trades only `live`: `await turnTo(tester, live);` ... `expect((ticket.symbol, ticket.side), (live.asset, live.direction));` with live = SOL/TradeSide.long (maker_suggestion.dart:40-41). Wiring is home_screen.dart:91-92 `symbol: item.asset,` / `side: item.direction,`. ETH short has `expiresAt: TradeMock.chartEnd.subtract(const Duration(hours: 2))` (maker_suggestion.dart:53), so it is never tradable at the seeded clock (`static final clock = ValueNotifier<DateTime>(TradeMock.chartEnd);`, scenario.dart:61). The file-level setUp (home_screen_test.dart:93-94) calls `Scenario.reset();`, which runs `clock.value = TradeMock.chartEnd;` (scenario.dart:266), so a test that writes the clock is cleaned up. Only the card and placeOrder read Scenario.clock in lib (grep), so moving it earlier changes nothing else. I dry-ran the proposed edits on a scratch copy of app/: the maker group passes (+15) and `flutter analyze` reports no issues. Mutant hardcode-sol-long (home_screen.dart `symbol: item.asset,` -> `symbol: 'SOL',` and `side: item.direction,` -> `side: TradeSide.long,`) SURVIVED the current maker group and is KILLED by the new test. The edit below also carries F2 (house rule 11: one test covers both).

verdicts.evidence: The card renders `'Reference ${s.referencePrice} · '` / `'${live ? 'expires in ${_span(left)}' : 'expired ${_span(-left)} ago'}'` (maker_suggestion.dart:111-115). The layout loop's text list (home_screen_test.dart:2868-2873) checks the badge, source, data path and rationale, but not this line. mutate-run-2.txt: `=== drop-reference-line: rc=0 SURVIVED`. The unit check at 2841-2842 is `// The demo quote itself, not a forked copy of it.` / `expect(s.referencePrice, TradeMock.quotes[s.asset]!.price);`, which is the getter body word for word (maker_suggestion.dart:31 `String get referencePrice => TradeMock.quotes[asset]!.price;`). TradeMock.quotes is `static const quotes = {` (trade_mock.dart:78), so no test can tell a forked copy holding today's value from the real thing, and the comment claims more than the check proves. At the seeded clock the expected strings are 'Reference $214.90 · expires in 4h' and 'Reference $2,968.40 · expired 2h ago'. On a scratch copy, three mutants SURVIVE the current group and are KILLED after the edit: drop-reference-line, span-sign (`'expired ${_span(-left)} ago'` -> `'expired ${_span(left)} ago'`, which renders 'expired -120m ago'), and ref-wrong-quote (`'Reference ${s.referencePrice} · '` -> `'Reference ${TradeMock.quotes['SOL']!.price} · '`). The patched group passes all 10 layout cases at 1.0x and 1.3x, and flutter analyze is clean.

verdicts.evidence: home_screen_test.dart:2917 `expect(find.textContaining('Confirm'), findsNothing);`. The only 'Confirm' label in the trade feature is order_ticket.dart:956 `_ => ('Confirm', _busy ? null : _confirm),`, inside _ReviewPanel. feed_order_ticket.dart only shows that panel after review: `child: _review != null` / `? _ReviewPanel(intent: _review!, requote: () => _intent)`, while the first screen holds Market/Limit tabs, leverage, amount and the side button (`'${widget.side.label} \$${_fmtUsd(_margin)} · ${_leverage}x'`, line 622). So an opened ticket never matches 'Confirm', and line 2916 `expect(find.byType(BottomSheet), findsNothing);` is the real guard. On a scratch copy, with line 2916 removed so 2917 stands alone, the production mutant vpb-ignores-enabled (vista_flow.dart `onTap: enabled ? onPressed : null,` -> `onTap: onPressed,`, which makes the disabled Expired button open the ETH ticket) SURVIVED with the old 2917. verdicts.evidence: app/lib/features/home/maker_suggestion.dart:95-99 renders `const VistaTag(label: 'Maker suggestion · advisory', color: VistaColors.accentTint, textColor: VistaColors.accent,)` inside a Container with `color: VistaColors.surface` (line 87). vista_colors.dart:11 `surface = Color(0xFF1F1F1F)`, :38 `accent = Color(0xFF5AA6DE)`, :39 `accentTint = Color(0x385AA6DE); // accent at 22%`, :20 `textPrimary = Color(0xFFF5F3FF)`. vista_chips.dart:66 VistaTag non-dense text style is `VistaType.labelStrong.copyWith(color: textColor)`; vista_typography.dart:104-107 labelStrong is `fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700` (small text, needs 4.5:1). Recomputed with WCAG relative luminance in python3: accentTint (alpha 0x38/255 = 0.2196) over #1F1F1F blends to rgb(43.96, 60.65, 72.95); accent on that = 4.264:1 (below 4.5), textPrimary on that = 10.278:1. Claim confirmed. Decision 10 fixes the shape: textPrimary on the existing accentTint fill, tokens only. No test pins the badge colour: the only test reference is home_screen_test.dart:2869, which checks `find.text('Maker suggestion · advisory').hitTestable()` findsOneWidget, not its style.
verdicts.rejectsValidInput: none - this is a colour token swap on one static label; it accepts and rejects no input. Checked: VistaTag's own default textColor is already VistaColors.textPrimary (vista_chips.dart:40), so the edit uses an existing token and an existing pairing; no document describes producing an accent-coloured badge label.
verdicts.testProof: Optional pin, runnable under scripts/gate.sh: in app/test/home_screen_test.dart, inside the maker-suggestion group after mounting a card, assert `expect(tester.widget<Text>(find.text('Maker suggestion · advisory')).style!.color, VistaColors.textPrimary);`. It fails against the current code (color is VistaColors.accent 0xFF5AA6DE) and passes after the edit. Without it nothing in the suite reaches the colour; the existing test at line 2869 only checks hit-testability.

edits.rationale: Decision 10: textPrimary on the existing accentTint fill measures 10.28:1, clearing the 4.5:1 small-text bar; tokens only, no new colour token. Kept explicit rather than deleting the line to fall back on VistaTag's default, so a future default change cannot silently regress it.
